subject: Burst reserve request — overnight throughput validation
messages:
From: Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@fastretail.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 20:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term credits for overnight throughput validation

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile. We have an internal window where we can run an overnight soak against our preprod traffic generators: target window is 2027-04-12 00:00–08:00 UTC.

Goal: validate sustained throughput at peak workload (approx. 1.8–2.2k reqs/s, simulated KB payloads) and confirm tail latencies under our 150ms p95 SLA. We estimate ~250k token-equivalent usage for the run.

Ask: can Redwood provision a temporary credit uplift and a short trial extension for that window? We only need access to the hosted sandbox endpoint (us-west region) and a voucher/allowance tied to account FR-2027-0456.

I've attached our load plan and a small test matrix — let me know if you need concurrency breakdowns or specific model variants to pin.

Thanks,
Anna Kovács
Senior ML Engineer — FastRetail
anna.kovacs@fastretail.ai

Attachments: fastretail_load_plan.csv (csv, 18KB), test_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@fastretail.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 21:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term credits for overnight throughput validation

Hi Anna — great to hear and thanks for the clear window + numbers. Looping in Jordan (sales ops) and Priyom (account lead) so we can get a short-term allowance in place. A couple quick clarifications to make sure we size correctly:

- Confirm you want hosted API sandbox in us-west (we can also route to eu if you'd prefer).
- Which model variant will you test? (gpt-redwood-medium / open-llm-70B / other) — token burn differs per model.
- Do you need any of these special conditions: fixed concurrency limit on the allowance, IP whitelisting for generators, or a one-time voucher code?

If you can reply with model and confirm region, we'll try to turn this around within a couple hours.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

--

Camila / Priyom — I can approve a provisional uplift for this window.

Provisioning details:
- 250,000 token credit reservation tied to FR-2027-0456
- Validity window: 2027-04-12 00:00–08:00 UTC (automatically expires at 08:00)
- Region: us-west (as requested)
- Note: we'll pin the allowance to the sandbox route + enforce the concurrency ceiling you specify.

Operational notes for Anna (cc'd): please ensure your load generators use the sandbox API key we provided in the demo. Marcus (ops) will monitor infra during the window for any GC/throughput anomalies — Priyom, can you add Marcus to the watch list?

Camila — I will create a voucher token and drop it in HubSpot + share the voucher code and redemption instructions to Anna. Priyom, please confirm if we should extend the trial end-date for FastRetail beyond the voucher window (i.e., a short trial extension to the account itself).

Jordan Blake
Sr. Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

Approval: provisional 250k token uplift authorized. Voucher to be issued and delivered to customer.
